actors.note: verified in the same build without --no-cheating (forwarded to roots only)

vstd.note: Verus standard library: the trusted base (its axioms and admits are Verus's own); not scanned

trust_inventory.premises: named in PROOFS.md (fairness premises of M07-L4 are hypotheses of the progress theorems); none is an assumption inside a proof

M01-L1.text: History only grows: every step keeps each record or turns it into its tombstone, and never lowers the head.
M01-L1.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M01-L2.text: Record and change together: when no transaction is open, the governed content equals the replay of the records, unless an unrecorded write was allowed (non-strict) and is flagged.
M01-L2.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M01-L3.text: A stale expected head (or a disabled ledger) refuses with a code and changes nothing.
M01-L3.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M01-L4.text: Strict mode: no write outside the ledger changes governed content while strict is on.
M01-L4.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M02-L1.text: At most one effect per request identity (post-commit effects included).
M02-L1.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M02-L2.text: A replay returns the first answer and changes nothing.
M02-L2.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M02-L3.text: Another payload under a bound key is refused and changes nothing.
M02-L3.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M02-L4.text: After the bound revision is redacted, the binding is gone (no replay, no text) and a retry is refused.
M02-L4.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M03-L1.text: Mutual exclusion: an exclusive holder excludes every other holder.
M03-L1.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M03-L2.text: Every guarded effect is made by a process that holds the lock.
M03-L2.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M03-L3.text: A marker is valid: while target t is marked, t is not live.
M03-L3.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M03-L4.text: Only the marker's owner clears it.
M03-L4.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M03-L5.text: No history of live content is tombstoned.
M03-L5.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M04-L1.text: Current or stale: when no writer is open, stamp = token implies D = f(S).
M04-L1.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M04-L2.text: Every source write path updates D in its transaction or moves the token.
M04-L2.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M04-L3.text: A rebuild leaves D = f(S) with the current stamp, or leaves it stale.
M04-L3.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M04-L4.text: A read from D answers f(S) or checks the signal and falls back.
M04-L4.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M05-L1.text: After erasure and a successful redaction of t, no store holds t's content unless the receipt names that store.
M05-L1.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M05-L2.text: Removing t changes no other target's content.
M05-L2.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M05-L3.text: The inventory lists every store any write path reaches.
M05-L3.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M06-L1.text: Round trip: a replacing restore of an archive saved at state s, with nothing written since, gives s on every store.
M06-L1.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M06-L2.text: A restore never lowers the ledger head below a live commit (it refuses or replays).
M06-L2.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M06-L3.text: A merge restore combines aggregates and counts only what it restored.
M06-L3.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M07-L1.text: Done means done: an entry is done only when its result was made from its current text.
M07-L1.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M07-L2.text: One worker per entry at a time.
M07-L2.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M07-L3.text: Bounded overtaking: while an entry is pending, at most N-1 other entries are served before it (N = distinct entries).
M07-L3.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M07-L4.text: Under weak fairness of the worker, every pending entry is served (no fair cycle keeps it pending); a resumed run can always finish.
M07-L4.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M08-L1.text: One schema: once recorded, the namespace's schema never changes and an engine asking for another is refused.
M08-L1.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M08-L2.text: Idempotent: setup on a current install changes nothing.
M08-L2.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M08-L3.text: Setup touches only the namespace's schema (and the fixed legacy manifest).
M08-L3.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M08-L4.text: A setting outside its domain is refused, never read as another value.
M08-L4.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M09-L1.text: Every entry validates the name; distinct valid names give distinct keys.
M09-L1.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M09-L2.text: A scoped read answers from its graph alone; an all-graphs read is the union of each graph's answer.
M09-L2.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M09-L3.text: A scoped write changes only its graph.
M09-L3.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M09-L4.text: The erase, liveness and record-match predicates of a target select the same content.
M09-L4.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M10-L1.text: All or none: at the end of a unit, both of its writes are kept or neither.
M10-L1.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M10-L2.text: Inert refusal: a refused unit leaves the caller's earlier writes as they were.
M10-L2.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M10-L3.text: A refused unit replies refused, with a code of its family; an ok reply means both writes are kept.
M10-L3.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M11-L1.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M11-L2.text: With keys on, a missing or wrong key is refused before any effect.
M11-L2.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M11-L3.text: No entry point reads, writes or deletes server files, or runs caller text as code.
M11-L3.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M12-L1.text: Every artifact records the graph and identity it was built for.
M12-L1.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M12-L2.text: A read or write checks the binding before using an artifact; a failed check refuses, never passes through.
M12-L2.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M12-L3.text: Distinct (graph, identity) pairs name distinct artifacts.
M12-L3.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)

M13-L1.text: A finished read returns parts of one committed state, or reports that it was interrupted.
M13-L1.status: proved generically over the trait (model level)
